name: BTC (Binary Triangle Descriptor)

what_exists_on_box.historical_pcd_layout: BTC runners expect NNNN.pcd next to run dir (see run_four_floor_btc_baseline.py)

exact_ask_for_Backend: Convert adapter Quad-Easy submaps `ncd_adapter/converted/quad-easy/submaps/0000.npy`…`0065.npy` (body-frame XYZ float32) → `NNNN.pcd` (or run BTC on npy if you have a loader). Confirm frame = body/lidar frame BTC expects.

Provide a runnable BTC env on box OR run yourself: `extract_candidates*` currently `ldd`-missing `libpcl_*.so.1.10`, `libroscpp`, `libopencv_core.so.4.2`, `libtbb`, `libglog`, `libcholmod`, `libcxsparse`.
Recommended profile for outdoor NCD: start from `vendor/btc/config/config_outdoor.yaml`; set `skip_near_num`≈10 (3 s nodes, ~30 s gap ≈ 10 frames), `candidate_num`≥50.
Deliver to Eval: `candidates.csv` with columns at least `i,j,score` (optionally rms, planes, T) for all 66 nodes, path e.g. `eval/ncd_quad_easy/results/baselines/btc_quad_easy/candidates.csv`.
Do NOT change multifloor/GNC core; this is a baseline retrieval dump only.
eval_will_score: R@k ±1 & tol=0 @2m/@3m on canonical 31/33 using same GT positives; P/R only if BTC emits an accept/verify set (usually retrieval-only → P/R N/A).
